# Rafiq v0.5.22 for Mac

- **GitHub Copilot sign-in works on every Mac.** The first sign-in downloads Copilot's runtime, and on a Mac without Python installed that download couldn't check GitHub's security certificate, so the sign-in failed. Rafiq now brings its own certificates.
- **A sign-in that fails says why.** If saving the sign-in fails after you approve on GitHub, Rafiq shows the reason instead of saying the code expired.
